effects.affects: Nothing until Clara is used to generate or update event content.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the assistant panel opens.

effects.does: Opens the interface for adding attachments.
effects.affects: Adds attachment records to the event when files are selected.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection interface appears.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.affects: Changes the event's terms_and_conditions data when clauses or attachments are saved.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Opens the line-item manager showing zero items.
effects.affects: Allows the event's line_items collection to be added, edited, or deleted.
effects.leadsTo: Manage line items drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Items 0 and verify that the manage line items interface opens with no items.

effects.does: Cannot save the event as a draft because the control is disabled.
effects.affects: Nothing because no draft save request is made.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Save as draft produces no request or navigation and that the disabled state remains.

effects.does: Validates the project and publishes the event when the required title, template, line items, and participants are present.
effects.affects: Creates or activates the event and advances it from creation toward the published event flow.
effects.leadsTo: Published event or project details screen
effects.check: Complete the required fields, click Publish, and verify a successful event-creation result and navigation.

effects.does: Opens or changes the auction setting for ranking bids by lot.
effects.affects: Changes the auction's ranking or lot-based closing configuration.
effects.leadsTo: Auction configuration drawer or stays here
effects.check: Click Rank on lot and verify that the lot-ranking setting changes or its configuration opens.

effects.does: Opens template selection for the event stage.
effects.affects: Sets the stage template required to configure and proceed with the event.
effects.check: Click Select Templates and verify that available templates are displayed.

effects.affects: Changes the event's audience_company_uuids and therefore which vendors can participate.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that vendors can be added or removed.

effects.does: Button is disabled because savings can only be configured after a template with savings enabled is selected.
effects.check: Hover and confirm tooltip "Please choose a template and add a product".

effects.does: Button is disabled because T&C editing requires a selected template and at least one line item.
effects.check: Hover and verify the same tooltip as other disabled footer buttons.

effects.does: Cannot be clicked because the event schedule control is disabled.
effects.affects: Nothing because no start or end schedule can be changed from this control.
effects.check: Verify that clicking the disabled schedule control does not open a scheduler.

effects.does: Keeps the Auction event-mode tab selected.
effects.affects: The event remains in auction mode rather than switching to another event mode.
effects.check: Verify that Auction is highlighted and that its configuration content is displayed.

effects.does: Navigates back to the Events area.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the Events page loads.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Accepts and updates the project title.
effects.affects: Changes the event group's title used in draft or publish payloads and validation.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the field value is retained.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Cannot search for or add vendors because the vendor selector is disabled.
effects.affects: No participant or audience_company_uuids record can be changed from this field.
effects.check: Verify that the selector cannot be focused or opened while disabled.

cases.title: Save as draft becomes enabled after adding a line item and selecting a template
steps: Choose any template from the list.
Add a line item with a product and quantity.
Observe the state of button "Save as draft".
cases.expected: Button "Save as draft" is now enabled. Tooltip on the button is no longer shown.
cases.setup: Screen is loaded with no line items and no template selected.

cases.title: Publish button shows tooltip when no participants are added
cases.expected: A toast or modal appears with message "Please add participants to proceed!" and publishing is blocked.
cases.setup: Template selected and at least one line item added, but no participants added.

cases.title: Attempt to publish with empty project title shows validation message
cases.expected: A validation toast appears with text "Please fill project title!" and the publish action is aborted.
cases.setup: Leave the title field blank, select a template and add a line item.

cases.title: Changing the selected template prompts confirmation dialog
cases.expected: A modal appears with message "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" and options "Yes" and "Cancel".
cases.setup: A template is already selected and line items are added.
gaps: Reliably choose a different template when the case provides no alternative template name.

cases.title: Publish with auction mode but no valid auction strategy shows error
cases.expected: A toast appears with message "Please select a valid auction strategy" and the project is not published.
cases.setup: Create a quick‑create auction project, select a template and add at least one line item, but leave the auction strategy unset.
gaps: The catalog cannot unset or create an invalid auction strategy; configure_single_stage only accepts valid strategies and defaults to Rank.

cases.title: Disabled "Now - 01:09 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins )" button shows tooltip until schedule is set
steps: Hover over button "Now - 01:09 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins )".
cases.expected: Button remains disabled and a tooltip appears with text "Please select template for <stage title>" or "Please add line items".
cases.setup: Screen loaded with no template selected and no line items.
gaps: The catalog cannot assert an OR condition accepting either the exact stage-specific message "Please select template for <stage title>" or "Please add line items"; it checks the template guidance substring only.
